AI Insights
What's Going Well
  • 178 stores complete vs. 154 target at Week 8 — +24 stores (+15.6%) ahead of plan. Weeks 5–8 each exceeded targets, with Week 5 delivering +14 stores above plan. Momentum is accelerating.
  • All 6 DHCP IP pool exhaustion incidents were resolved on-site during migration windows — no post-migration tickets and no return visits required. THD network team response is same-window reliable.
  • 6,433 handsets deployed across 178 stores (avg. 36/store). Week 5 alone deployed 1,214 phones — the program has proven it can execute at scale heading into the high-volume ramp.
Areas of Concern
  • Phones provisioned but left in MDF at 13 stores due to locked rooms, blocked 110 blocks, or restricted access. Return visit scheduling is needed before these can be marked complete.
  • 110-block cabling at 20 stores prevented the VG410 swap — legacy VG reconfigured and left in place. Physical swaps remain pending and will require a separate mobilization wave.
  • 71 stores scheduled for Week 9 vs. a 40-store target — the first high-volume week. Capacity for Cisco engineers, THD MEs, and freight coordination should be verified before May 4 kickoff.

Key Cost-Saving Actions
Do not remobilize — finish Southeast first
Field team already in GA/FL. Returning later for 330 SE stores = $40–60K redeployment cost. Complete all 10 SE states through Week 15 before moving north.
Northeast corridor: highest-efficiency phase
NY/NJ/PA = 240 stores within 150 miles of Newark. 60-store weeks achievable. The only phase where a second parallel team has strong ROI.
California is a program within the program
235 CA stores = 12% of remaining program. Lease Ontario CA staging warehouse. Plan 4 pure CA weeks — do not mix with OR/WA.
Start Canada authorization at Week 16 — not later
Miss the window and Canada shifts onto the critical path, adding 3–4 weeks. Assign an owner to ATA carnet processing this week.
Consider a second TX-only sub-team
TX at 50/wk = 4 weeks. Two sub-teams (DFW-north + Houston-south) compresses TX to 2 weeks. ~$8K incremental cost, 2 weeks saved.
Bundle territory logistics into one coordinated trip
PR + USVI share SJU Atlantic mobilization. GU shares freight with WC team's AK trip. Pre-ship all island equipment 3 weeks ahead.
